submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE independent native HD>=1024 square RGBA transparent game-animation frame. Image1 is the edit target: retain exact head/hair, torso, both arms sleeves hands weapons and canvas scale/position. Redraw ONLY legs and adjoining skirt fabric. Image2 is same-character leg anatomy reference. Image3 is approved grounding anatomy only, never copy its identity, bow, clothes. Image4 identity; image5 approved painted style. DIRECTION N pure rear view running away. Anatomical RIGHT hand sword must remain on screen-right, LEFT hand blue rectangular talisman on screen-left. Exactly two connected legs, short original limb proportions. Frame05 of16: RIGHT screen-right foot stays planted while BODY PASSES it, stage3 pair A. Right shin angles subtly BACK toward viewer from knee to grounded ankle, heel DOWN, right boot now just behind pelvis along travel, near94% canvas; do not expose full shoe sole. LEFT airborne knee begins moving forward, lower left shoe slightly ahead/deeper. Preserve right support ownership from image2 even though old image1 is toe-off. Same support foot must stay loaded on the world ground for 8 frames, with four progressive fore-aft ground positions, two independent poses per position. In rear view ground depth changes projected shoe height; never force all shoe-bottoms to a horizontal line. Keep feet axes straight NORTH, no outward toe yaw. Natural bent knees and meaningful weight; no standing mannequin, no extra limbs, no whole-character translation or scale change. Never move head or arms to compensate. Genuine transparent alpha; no shadow, guide, text, contact line or background.
